title: crater.settings.json
description: How crater installs packages in this project: folder names, aliases and what it may change.

$schema.description: Lets editors show these descriptions. crater ignores it.

import_client_path.description: Folder for import_client packages, for example Packages.

import_server_path.description: Folder for import_server packages, for example ServerPackages.

import_develop_path.description: Folder for import_develop packages, for example DevPackages.

import_client_alias.description: Name of the .luaurc alias for the client folder, so require("@Packages/Promise") works. Empty uses the folder name.

import_server_alias.description: Name of the .luaurc alias for the server folder. Empty uses the folder name.

import_develop_alias.description: Name of the .luaurc alias for the dev folder. Empty uses the folder name.

on_install_update_luaurc.description: true adds the package folder aliases to .luaurc on every install.

on_install_update_vscode_luau_definition.description: true adds the .d.luau files of installed packages to .vscode/settings.json for luau-lsp.

on_install_should_i_ask_your_permission_.description: true asks before every action that changes files. -y skips the question once.

link_style.description: How link files require packages: roblox uses script.Parent paths, string uses require("./name") paths.
